scope.story_boundary: State the smallest world boundary that can affect the supplied story.
excluded_or_unknown: State one deliberately excluded or unresolved scale.

locations.name: Story-facing location
locations.story_function: State the choice, conflict, evidence, or outcome this location enables.
material_conditions: State one physical, ecological, or infrastructure condition.
access_constraints: State who or what limits entry, movement, knowledge, or use.
locations.basis: Trace the location to supplied material or label the creative proposal.

factions.name: Story-facing faction
factions.objective: State the result this organized group seeks.
resources: State one usable resource, capability, or form of legitimacy.
factions.social_consequence: State how the faction changes access, power, burden, or conflict.
factions.basis: State why this faction is being proposed.

institutions.name: Story-facing institution
institutions.authority: State what the institution may decide, record, distribute, or enforce.
dependencies: State one material, informational, legal, or social dependency.
beneficiaries: State who gains from the institution's normal operation.
burdened_groups: State who carries cost, exclusion, exposure, or delay.
institutions.social_consequence: State the resulting choice or conflict.
institutions.basis: State the supplied fact or proposal that supports this institution.

history.event: State one past event with an active present effect.
history.legacy: State what present claim, infrastructure, memory, or behavior it changes.
history.evidence: State whether the event is documented, remembered, disputed, or proposed.
history.basis: State the source or proposal basis.

cultures.name: Bounded cultural practice
values: State one value demonstrated through action.
material_practices: State how the practice uses objects, places, labor, or resources.
internal_variation: State one disagreement, exception, or alternate interpretation within the group.
cultures.social_consequence: State how the practice changes choice, status, access, or conflict.
cultures.basis: State the supplied fact or proposal basis without generalizing beyond it.

systems.name: Story-relevant system
dependencies: State one environmental, technical, social, or institutional dependency.
systems.basis: State why the system is required; omit systems entirely when none are needed.

rules.name: Observable world rule
rules.statement: State one repeatable relation in observable terms.
rules.cost: State what use consumes, risks, damages, owes, exposes, or displaces.
rules.limit: State what the rule cannot do or where it stops.

contradiction_checks.scenario: State a later situation that would challenge this rule.
contradiction_checks.expected_behavior: State what should happen if the rule still holds.
contradiction_checks.resolution: State whether to revise the claim, preserve uncertainty, or propose an explicit approved change.

rules.basis: Trace this rule to supplied evidence or label it as a proposal.
rules.story_consequence: State the choice, conflict, knowledge, risk, or outcome this rule changes.

terminology.definition: Define the observable condition this term names.
terminology.usage_boundary: State what the term must not imply.
terminology.basis: State why stable working language is needed.

production_assets.name: Trackable production asset
production_assets.world_function: State the asset's story-facing world function.
production_assets.production_use: State why it must be designed, built, generated, acquired, versioned, or continuity-controlled.
production_assets.basis: State why this entity is an actual production asset rather than abstract lore.

assumptions: State one provisional interpretation or leave this array empty.
uncertainties: State one unresolved fact, range, mechanism, approval, or evidence gap.
